title: Startup Social: Novella Center for Entrepreneurship Founder Showcase, Angel Investing Panel, Immersive Experience
description: Join Spark Coworking and Novella Center for Entrepreneurship for an evening of startup discovery, community connection, and hands-on investing. The event kicks off with open networking and introductions from Spark and Novella Center, followed by a dynamic panel discussion, “How to Invest in a Startup Without a Fund.” Designed for aspiring investors, founders, and curious community members, this conversation will explore what investors look for in early-stage companies, how investment decisions are made, and how anyone can begin supporting startups, even if they’ve never considered themselves an investor before. After the panel, meet the next generation of entrepreneurs during the Novella Center for Entrepreneurship Founder Showcase, where selected founders will pitch their ventures and share their vision for growth. Then, put the panel’s insights into action. Each attendee will receive Spark Bucks, a mock investment currency to allocate among the showcased startups. Cast your vote for the companies you believe have the strongest potential and see how your investment instincts compare with other attendees and our expert panelists. Whether you’re a founder seeking feedback, a professional interested in startup investing, or simply looking to connect with Baltimore’s entrepreneurial ecosystem, this event offers a unique opportunity to learn, engage, and support emerging businesses. Achinth Murali (Open Judgement Engineering): The Open Judgment Engine (OJE) is an open-source methodology and AI-assisted platform that captures the reasoning behind non-routine engineering decisions — when a judgment applies, when it doesn’t, what the expert does, why it works, and what failure it guards against — as structured, attributed artifacts called Judgment Primitives, embedded directly into the workflow gates where engineers already make those decisions. description: Startup Social: How to Get PaidSpark Coworking You’re invited to join us for our next Startup Social. We’re focusing on something every founder eventually faces: how to turn what you’re building into revenue. We’re gathering a small group of founders to share how they approached it early on. The format is conversational but structured, with a mix of short prompts, shared experiences, and open discussion. *Founder Conversation*A moderated discussion with founders sharing how they found their first customers, when they started charging, and what helped things click. Short questions like:– How would you make your first $1K today?– What worked to get your first paying customer?– What you would do differently now? *Open Feedback Moments*We’ll invite a few attendees to share what they’re working on and get perspective from the room. *Student Founder Spotlight*We’ll recognize the Spark Impact Award winners from the Maryland Student Venture Competition, in partnership with Upsurge Baltimore, and hear briefly about what they’re building. *After the conversation*We’ll transition into a relaxed happy hour. Time to meet people, continue conversations, and connect with others in the community. *Bonus*Everyone who attends will receive a complimentary day pass to cowork at Spark at a future date. *Who this is for*Founders working toward their first or next stage of revenuePeople building something new and figuring out what comes nextAnyone who values honest conversations and being in the right room Startup Social is about showing up, sharing openly, and learning from each other.
